name: branding-family-supplement-lifestyle-and-ingredient-photo-collection
title: Family kitchen lifestyle shots and bright colour-block ingredient still lifes with supplement tubs
whatItIs: A tall collage of ten photos: a mother and toddler holding a tub in a bright kitchen, a smoothie blend, a child and mother playing with gummies, flat lays of tubs among vegetables on pale blue, a net bag on blue, hearts falling behind lab glass on pink, tubs with produce on green, a red basket on chequered floor, gummies pouring into a beaker and picnic scenes.
whatItMeans: Warm, fresh and honest; real families and vivid ingredient colour backdrops make health feel joyful.
techniques: Alternate natural kitchen lifestyle photos with graphic colour-block still lifes.
Style products with the ingredients they contain.
Use a strong single-colour backdrop per still life.
Add playful props like falling hearts and lab glass.

vocabulary.definition: Placing a product with the foods it contains.
A product photo on a bold flat colour.
A photo of the product in daily use.
Objects chosen to hint at a product idea.
